summary: Enhance your skills with our Leading Performance Appraisals Course. Learn to conduct impactful appraisals that drive employee performance and engagement.
lede: Performance appraisal training helps HR managers, department heads and team leads evaluate employee work against clear goals and behavioral standards. It develops practical skills in setting KPIs and SMART targets, using behaviorally anchored rating scales and 360-degree feedback, mitigating bias, and conducting appraisal conversations, with practice in creating improvement plans and reporting performance data.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for talent oversight, organizational equity, and team productivity across all sectors.
modules: Defining Standards with KPIs and SMART Goals
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of organizational structures and at least six months of experience in a supervisory or HR-related role. Familiarity with standard office productivity software is required for the digital dashboard exercises.
